text: Hey, can you text Allie for me? I'd love it if she hosted a little get-together at her place this Saturday around 3:30 and invited Jordan. I'd rather she didn't mention me at all though, just invite him like it's her own idea. Things have been a bit awkward between Jordan and me lately and I don't want him to feel it's about me, so it would land better coming from you.
